257024|d62b45b0.name: Mendalass Tattermend
257024|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

837-progress.name: Gar'Thok
837-progress.text: Though they do possess some intelligence and some organization, I find it constantly amazing that the quilboars were able to capture and hold so much territory in Kalimdor. Perhaps they are more crafty an enemy than I give them credit for...
837-progress.title: Encroachment

92460-accept.name: Ailee Farheart
92460-accept.text:
Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We need all the help we can get here in Thendal Village and your arrival is most welcome. I imagine you are brimming with nerves for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.

Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.
92460-accept.title: Coming of Age

92465-accept.name: Yala Windwatcher
92465-accept.text:
The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent.

Regrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. We also need to send a clear message to the cult that they are not welcome in the grove.

Will you lend me your aid, $c?
92465-accept.title: Agitators

92469-accept.name: Yala Windwatcher
92469-accept.text:
You've done enough here, $c. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.

Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.
92469-accept.title: Return to Rorian

92482-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92482-accept.text: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident $c trainer--Tai'ree Farsight--left this note for you. You can find her just over yonder near the center of the village. Read the note then seek her out.
92482-accept.title: The Way of the Hunter

92482-complete.name: Tai'ree Farsight
92482-complete.text:
The way of the $c is fraught with danger, and only those with the keenest senses and quickest reflexes can thrive in the wilds. I look at you and I am reminded of myself when I stood before my mentor, so many years ago. I believe that you have what it takes, but in the end that is up to you alone.

Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.
92482-complete.title: The Way of the Hunter

92595-accept.name: Illaya Amberwind
92595-accept.text:
<Illaya smiles warmly at you.>

I am glad you returned to speak with me, child of the winds. I knew it the first moment you walked into my presence, that you were strong in the skysight. Do you find this surprising? Even those who have not trained as a Shaman may possess the gift. 

Come, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92595-accept.title: The Windshapers

94411-accept.name: Illaya Amberwind
94411-accept.text:
Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. Prove your resolve to us by going to the standing stones and dispersing them.

I am loathe to condone outright bloodshed, but do what you must to drive them off. Return to me when it's done.
94411-accept.title: Meddlesome Mages

96101-progress.name: Raan Wildwind
96101-progress.text: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors is critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.
96101-progress.title: The Great Outdoors

96655-progress.name: Cook Torka
96655-progress.text: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
96655-progress.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96875-accept.name: Kamari
96875-accept.text:
Orgrimmar is always expanding, $c. And when the peons need hides to line the walls and roofs of our new buildings, they come to me!

The hides of the lizards in Thunder Ridge are typically too thick for armor, but they make excellent building material. Bring me some of their hides, along with a few lighter cured hides. Let's see your skill with leather!
96875-accept.title: Beasts of Thunder Ridge

97326-accept.name: Thra
97326-accept.text:
Hey! You've got time to help us out! I know you do, I can tell by the way you smiled watching the game we're playing.

This spot behind Grommash Hold is nice because it's clear enough for us to set up our figures. But what stinks is we don't have enough rocks for chairs or tables.

You're big and strong... d'ya think you could carry back some medium-sized rocks, smooth enough to sit on if we need a rest?
97326-accept.title: Rocks to Rests

97326-complete.name: Thra
97326-complete.text:
How can you even hold all of those boulders!

Those are great. Most even have a nice flat side, too. Now that you carried them all the way over here we can scoot them around in the dirt, right where we want 'em.

Thanks, $N!
97326-complete.title: Rocks to Rests

97326-progress.name: Thra
97326-progress.text: It's nice to not have to always sit in the dirt!
97326-progress.title: Rocks to Rests

97906-accept.name: Brakk
97906-accept.text:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97906-accept.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97906-complete.name: Karolek
97906-complete.text:
There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97906-complete.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97907-progress.name: Krunn
97907-progress.text: I can teach you to develop your skills.
97907-progress.title: Camping 101: Mining
